th the same id every existing run still points at.\n- [Archive an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/
archive-an-environment.md): Archive an environment. It stops being selectable for runs and frees its name for a new one, but the r
ow is kept and can be restored — this is why archive is a sub-action rather than a DELETE. Requires `expectedRevision` — the revis
ion you last read. If the environment changed since, the write is re…\n- [Restore an archived environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com
/api-reference/environments/restore-an-archived-environment.md): Restore an archived environment. Returns 409 if another live envi
ronment took its name in the meantime. Plugin pins whose version row no longer exists at all are dropped on the way back to live —
compare the returned `pluginVersionIds` against what you archived to detect that. Requires `expectedRevi…\n- [List a project's sc
enarios](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-projects-scenarios.md): The studies published from this project — na
me, access mode, attached servers, and share link. Read-only.\n- [Publish an environment for user testing](https://docs.mcpjam.com
/api-reference/studies/publish-an-environment-for-user-testing.md): PUT, not POST, because publishing is IDEMPOTENT: one study per
environment, and publishing an already-published environment returns the existing one rather than minting a second. `created` say
s which happened.\n- [Unpublish an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/unpublish-an-environment.md): Takes
the study down. Deliberately NOT behind the beta gate that guards publishing: an organization that loses the flag must still be ab
le to take a live study down.\n- [Get a study](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/get-a-study.md): One study's full rea
d: execution settings (model, system prompt, tool-approval policy, attached servers, share link), the environment it publishes, an
d the insights envelope over its latest analyzed window.\n- [Update a scenario](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/upda
te-a-scenario.md): Change a study's identity or its exposure — but not both in one call. **Send `mode` on its own.** Identity and
exposure are separate operations upstream, and applying them in sequence could leave the study live in a mode you did not ask for.
\n- [List a scenario's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-scenarios-sessions.md): What visitors did, a
s summaries. Project members only — this route is deliberately absent from the guest allowlist, so a share-link visitor can never
read other visitors' sessions.\n- [Get a session transcript](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/get-a-session-transcrip
t.md): The projected transcript, paged. Tool payloads and blobs are dropped, and the stored blob URL is never returned.\n- [Set th
e guest-execution caps](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/set-the-guest-execution-caps.md): The spend dial for anonymo
us visitors. A FULL REPLACEMENT — send every field. These caps only mean something as a set, and a partial update that raised one
while leaving another stale would produce a combination nobody chose.\n- [Rotate the share link](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/studies/rotate-the-share-link.md): Mints a new share link and stops the old URL from granting access. Everyone you shared it
with needs the new one.\n- [Invite a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/invite-a-member.md): Upsert by email, s
o re-inviting somebody is not an error. Only meaningful while `mode` is `invited_only`.\n- [Remove a member](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/api-reference/studies/remove-a-member.md): Removal NARROWS access, so it bumps `accessVersion` and cuts off any session that me
mber already had — it takes effect at once rather than at expiry.\n- [Point a scenario at a different environment](https://docs.mc
pjam.com/api-reference/studies/point-a-scenario-at-a-different-environment.md): Keeps the study's LINK, its members and its sessio
n history while changing what visitors actually reach. The alternative — unpublish and republish — mints a new link, which means r
e-sharing it with everyone.\n- [Session metrics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/session-metrics.md): Volumes, compl
etion and feedback rates over the study's sessions.\n- [Usage breakdown](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/usage-break
down.md): Which models, tools and servers the study's sessions used.\n- [Current window signals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/studies/current-window-signals.md): What the miner extracted from the current window — and where you get the window id the in
sights read takes.\n- [List scenario findings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-scenario-findings.md): Every fin
ding raised over this study's windows, dismissed ones included — dismissal is a state on the finding, not a deletion.\n- [Read a w
indow's insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/read-a-windows-insights.md): Poll this after requesting a generati
on.\n- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/request-insights-for-the-current-wi
ndow.md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the study's current window and draws on the
organization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS and is SHARED with eval-run and swarm run insights, so a request he
re takes one from there.\n- [Cancel a window's generation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/cancel-a-windows-generati
on.md): Releases a generation that is stuck `pending`. Idempotent against an already-finished one.\n- [Dismiss a finding](https://
docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/dismiss-a-finding.md): Keyed on the finding's stable remediation id, so the same problem sta
ys dismissed when insights regenerate. Bodyless: the path names the finding.\n- [Restore a dismissed finding](https://docs.mcpjam.
com/api-reference/studies/restore-a-dismissed-finding.md): Undoes a dismissal. Bodyless: the path names the finding.\n- [Create (o
r revive) a relay tunnel for a named project server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/create-or-revive-a-relay-tunnel
-for-a-named-project-server.md): Registers a server record named `name` if missing, mints a relay tunnel grant for it, and **persi
sts the tunnel bearer URL (including the plaintext `?k=` secret) onto the server record's `url`** so evals and studies can target
the tunnel like any remote server. The plaintext persistence is a deliber…\n- [Revoke a tunnel's live grant](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/api-reference/tunnels/revoke-a-tunnels-live-grant.md): Revokes the grant at the control plane and edge: the public URL stops wo
rking immediately and any live tunnel session is disconnected. The server record — including its now-dead `url` — is intentionally
left untouched, so the next create revives the tunnel with the same slug.\n- [List a project's plugins](https://docs.mcpjam.com/a
pi-reference/plugins/list-a-projects-plugins.md): The live (installed, non-uninstalled) Agent Plugins in the project, disabled one
s included (marked `enabled: false`). Read-only: import, activation, enable/disable and uninstall are app flows, not API operation
s.\n- [Get a plugin version](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/plugins/get-a-plugin-version.md): One imported plugin version w
ith its component projections: declared MCP servers (placement, auth timing, materialized server id) and declared skills (namespac
ed model refs). Addressed by the version id alone — access is membership of the version's own project, and historical versions of
uninstalled…\n- [List a project's skills](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/skills/list-a-projects-skills.md): The Cloud Skill
s visible to the caller in this project: the project-shared ones plus the caller's own drafts. Each row reports `pinnability`, whi
ch is what decides whether its id is usable in an environment's `skillSelection`.\n- [Get a skill](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-ref
erence/skills/get-a-skill.md): One skill, including its SKILL.md body. The body is mutable and an edit overwrites the previous one
in place, so `aggregateHash` is the only handle on which content this read returned.\n- [Run one headless agent turn](https://doc
s.mcpjam.com/api-reference/agent/run-one-headless-agent-turn.md): Runs ONE assistant turn over the supplied message history and re
